flashcard_questions.q: Which string technique gives a playful or quirky effect?

notes: 15 cards: 3 instrument-to-family cards, 3 composer-to-film cards (Jaws, Batman, How to Train Your Dragon), 3 example-to-feature cards on the named scores (low strings in Jaws, accents, brass in Batman), and 6 articulation term-to-meaning cards (legato, staccato, tenuto, tremolo, con sordino, pizzicato). Senza sordino and double stopping were dropped to stay inside 15, and the MAD T SHIRT framework was left out as exam method rather than content.
